usage: 有力 is used to describe someone or something that has a lot of strength or energy.
It can refer to physical strength or an energetic spirit.
You can use 有力 to praise a person's effort or a strong action.
It is often used in everyday conversation to describe things or people that appear powerful or energetic.
有力 usually comes after the subject and before the noun or verb it describes.
